messages:
mira: quick heads-up, ops wants a clearer signal from clients for route intent. proposing X-Route-Priority header (compact wire form) + structured SDK meta. need SDK impacts + console telemetry mapping.
leo: can we get a short explainer of what goes into the header? trying to judge parsing/alloc cost in ts lib.
jamie: core idea: header is a compact semicolon list with fields we control: p=<priority int>;pool=<pool-id>;src=<source>. e.g. 
```
X-Route-Priority: p=20;pool=eu-west-ml;src=py-sdk
```
This avoids JSON on the wire and keeps proxies small. Runtime treats it as a hint only.
oana: for py-sdk, adding a RouteMeta param to client call is easy. question: should SDK emit the compact string or let platform transform a structured metadata field into the header at the edge?
mira: two tradeoffs: emitting in SDK reduces edge transformations (fewer moving pieces) but forces all SDKs implement encoding. delegating to edge centralizes logic but loses per-client opt-in visibility.
chris: TS/Go libs already have encoder helpers for other headers. i'd prefer SDKs emit compact wire form to keep runtime stateless. small helper to build header from structured object.
leo: good. that means TS will parse user-provided RouteMeta object and then call encodeRouteMeta(). cheap to implement. we should publish ABNF for the header so parsers are deterministic.
jamie: agreed. ABNF in proposal doc. also include canonical ordering of fields to make deduping/observability easier: p, pool, src.
oana: tests: will add unit tests verifying both forms accepted by runtime: structured meta via dev proxy and compact header via wire. e2e in staging will validate quota attribution unchanged during canary.
mira: console needs a dashboard tile mapping requested priority -> applied pool -> quota owner. chris, can we surface both requested and applied in the same row?
chris: yes. plan: "Requested" (header p/pool) vs "Runtime" (applied pool + decision reason). also a histogram of priority distribution. sampling should be enabled initially to avoid ingestion blowup.
infra-bot: staging-check: edge-proxy (green), telemetry-ingest (yellow - high lag), sdk-py-canary (pending).
leo: versioning: non-breaking addition to SDK API: add optional RouteMeta param. we'll release as patch w/ type in ts/go but not enabled by default, then minor release that emits header when set. keeps semver tidy.
oana: python: add dataclass RouteMeta, add client param route_meta: Optional[RouteMeta] = None. will emit header only when not None.
jamie: make sure header encoding handles escaping for pool ids with special chars. ABNF will define allowed chars.
mira: rollout plan draft:
- week 1: spec + ABNF + SDK stubs (all langs) + runtime reader accepts header but does nothing else. telemetry captures header string.
- week 3: canary: SDKs in internal test apps emit header; console shows requested vs applied (sampling enabled). no billing changes.
- week 6: opt-in tenant flag to enable quota attribution by header where applicable. monitor results.
- week 12: evaluate for default flip on new tenants after safety checks.
chris: telemetry note: store header verbatim in a single string column to avoid schema churn, then parse in downstream jobs. sampling key at ingestion so we only parse a subset initially.
leo: docs: need small code snippets for py/ts/go showing how to construct RouteMeta and the wire result. i'll add ts/go snippets. oana can add python snippet.
oana: on it. will include a simple example: 
```py
from redwood import Client, RouteMeta
c = Client()
resp = c.generate("hi", route_meta=RouteMeta(priority=15, pool='eu'))
```
jamie: ops edge: ensure proxies pass header through unchanged. some infra components strip unknown headers by default. we need a list of routes to whitelist.
mira: good catch. ops will add to proxy passthrough allowlist. infra-bot: proxy-config PR opened (#4321).
chris: console UX: add a tiny "Requested priority matches applied" indicator green/yellow/red in route details. helps tenants debug.
mira: ok, action items: leo open TS/Go issues + ABNF draft, oana open py-sdk PR w/ tests, chris mock console tile, jamie validate proxy passthrough, i'll publish spec doc and coordinate tenant opt-in flag.
leo: i'll also add encoder util in ts client lib and a test for special char escaping.
oana: starting PR today, targeting canary next week.
mira: thanks all. will reconvene after staging canary. :thumbsup:
